task: Open last chat after page change and collapse other folders in the redesigned Chats side panel.

key_reasoning.reason: Coordinates two code paths: useChatNavigation.tsx (router-level last-chat resolution) and expandSectionForLocation in chatSidebarSectionsHelpers.ts (sidebar folder-tab opening). Both must cooperate correctly to avoid regressing the folder-accumulation bug prevented by the existing 'clear then open one' pattern elsewhere in the sidebar hooks.

No exact precedent in the useChatNavigation or expandSectionForLocation paths themselves, though the 'clear then open one' pattern is well-established in expandFolder/scrollToChat/handleCreateFolder. Regression risk is concrete: neither useChatNavigation nor the 'folder' branch of expandSectionForLocation has any existing test coverage, and the folder-accumulation failure mode the pattern prevents is documented in useChatSidebarNavigation.ts (lines 115–116) as a previously-hit bug.

Clear and unambiguous: 'open last chat after page change' leverages existing chatsStore.currentChat → getLastChat() logic; 'collapse other folders' applies the proven 'clear then open one' pattern to the'folder' branch of expandSectionForLocation. Technical analysis identifies the exact code seams and precedent patterns.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M to L: Coordinates two code paths (useChatNavigation + expandSectionForLocation) with regression risk (folder-accumulation bug that the existing 'clear then open one' pattern was designed to prevent).
